author: DaiqingChen
body:
**From geneontology/go-ontology#31132** 

Microfibril is a more specific complex under elastic fiber. In the review PMID: 16893474 and PMID: 23962539, if the elastic-fibre location is microfibril or all the other members in the family are in microfibril, label gene as microfibril. 
If the elastic-fibre location is in the microfibril-elastin interface, or not sure about being a microfibril product, label gene as elastic fiber. #6023

title: New annotations for microfibril (GO:0001527)

author: DaiqingChen
body: @Matrisome  COL16A1 is listed as in Dermal microfibrils in the review, but you wrote in the Nov 26 note that it should be add to elastic fiber. May I ask why?

author: Matrisome
body: @DaiqingChen You are correct, COL16A1 should be listed under nicrofibrils, not elastic fibers.
